instruction: In cell B13, calculate the average sales for January across all sales representatives using the AVERAGE function.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating average of January sales. Verified with Python: 4852 / 10 = 485.2. Evaluator checks if cell B13 contains this value with tolerance of 0.1 for floating point precision.
